_note: Intra-Germanic blend (Anglo-Saxon + Norse): the Cwealmingas, the 'kin of slaughter' (OE cwealm = death/killing), a cruel reaver folk of fen, dark forest and hill. Backbone = Anglo-Saxon (phonology, -ingas kin-names, ealdor/thegn ladder); overlay = Norse (sea-raiding jarls, longships, -son/-by). clan = clanhold. CHAOTIC ALONE. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real OE/Norse register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are the Anglo-Saxon-branch reflexes (with Norse-overlay variants) of the common-Germanic theonym ancestors (family_germanic.json), phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real Germanic/Norse gods.

phonology.palette: Old English: retain w-; au>ea, ai>a; th retained; weak -a/-e endings; -ingas kin-names; Norse-overlay -r, -by, -son among the sea-raiders; theophoric stems are the Chaotic-power reflexes (Mearox-, Waecid-, Lusand-).
phonology.phonotactics: CVC and clusters (cw, sc, hl, hr, hw, br, st); root-initial stress.

morphology.patronymic_form: patronymic -sunu / -ing (descendant of); kin (cynn) name; Norse-overlay -son among the sea-raiders; cruel deed-bynames common.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|animal](stem) + feature/settlement: Sweart-weald (black-forest), Cwealm-ham (slaughter-home); kin + -ingas; Norse-overlay -by/-thorp for raider-steads.

title_ladder.government: clanhold (a cruel war-folk of ealdormen and reaver-jarls; the witan/moot is a thing of threats)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Anglo-Saxon clanhold, ascending, with a Norse raiding overlay. Thegn (retainer-lord) barony; Mearc-weard (march-warden) march; Scir-gerefa (shire-reeve) county; Heretoga (war-leader) duchy; Ealdor (chief-lord) principality; Cyning (king) kingdom; Bretwalda (wide-ruler) empire over the Brytenrice. Sea-raider bands answer to Norse-style jarls. (Rank titles are the real OE/Norse register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: personal + -ing patronymic or cynn; reavers add a cruel deed-byname (the Render, Corpse-maker); Norse -son among the raider-kin.
people_name_convention.dual_register: the ealdor-kin carry cynn + war-byname; commoners a patronymic.
people_name_convention.theophoric: the Cwealmingas swear by the CHAOTIC powers: names from the Anglo-Saxon (and Norse-overlay) Chaotic deity-reflexes + an element: -wulf (wolf), -gar (spear), Cwealm- (slaughter): e.g. Mearox-wulf, Cwealm-gar.

religion._note: The Cwealmingas are Chaotic alone: they venerate the CHAOTIC powers directly, by their Anglo-Saxon reflexes (with Norse-overlay variants among the sea-raiders) - phoneme-morphs of the Agrippan canon, never real Germanic/Norse gods. The Lawful powers are the hated 'thrall-gods' of weak folk, named only to curse; the One is reviled as the distant tyrant.
religion.the_one: Aetern the Far Tyrant (< *Aiternaz < Aeternus; reviled, never petitioned)

sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Mearox (the War-Fire, the city-burner; chief idol)

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the LAWFUL powers are the enemy-gods, named to curse, each with a scornful epithet: Tulrius -> Thulor the Thrall-Light; Orlandus -> Eorland the Oath-Chain; Aeternus -> Aetern the Far Tyrant. (Norse-overlay raiders curse them in the Norse reflexes: Thulr, Orlund.)
religion.religious_orders_pattern: the Hearg (idol-grove) of [power]: 'the Hearg of Mearox', where the blood-offerings hang.
religion.saints_pattern: the worst reavers are honored as the Wael-deade (the slaughter-dead), their skulls set in the hearg; 'the dread [name]'.

holy_symbol_motifs.Mearox: a burning city under a black wolf's jaws
holy_symbol_motifs.Waecid: an open mouth swallowing a broken sun

banks_patterns.military_units: the [cynn] Slaughter-band / the [animal] reavers: 'the Wolf-Cwealmingas', 'the Fenn-Reavers'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: blood-heargs and corpse-fens: 'the Hearg of [name]', 'the Drowned Burh of [kin]'
